title: Restaurant SaaS Multi-Tenant
purpose: Tenant-oriented sample showing one generated restaurant app shared by multiple restaurants through explicit tenant references.
businessStory: Pizza House, Sushi Bar, and Vegan Bistro share one generated app while tenant-owned concepts keep their data scoped by tenant reference fields.
walkthrough: Generate and run the sample app.
Populate the tenant seed data for the three restaurants.
Verify that tenant-shaped records remain distinguishable through tenant references and runtime evidence.
expectedOutcomes: Tenant-shaped concepts are generated with explicit tenant references.
Seeded tenant data can be populated and verified.
The sample demonstrates modeled tenancy without over-claiming authenticated tenant isolation.
